meta.name: qBittorrent
meta.longDescription: qBittorrent-nox headless client. Pairs with the Radarr/Sonarr pups as their download client, with finished downloads bridged into the Jellyfin library by the host sync timer. Web UI on port 8080. New in 0.0.6: fixes the 0.0.5 release — its bubblewrap sandbox cannot run inside Dogebox nspawn containers (proc mount denied, restart-loop); reverts to direct exec, keeps the HostHeaderValidation fix and conf template.
